searches.reason: Turn feedback about redundancy, useful complements, compatibility, and media preferences into auditable diagnostics. Seek evidence-grounded rubrics using only histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps, with explicit abstention when purpose or compatibility cannot be established. Validate automated judgments against human annotations; keep the twenty-user panel exploratory and distinguish unresolved cases from rejection.
searches.query: 2024 2025 2026 recommendation diagnostic evaluation grounded user feedback complementary versus redundant products media preference mismatch selective prediction abstention human annotation rubric

searches.reason: Extend history edits into controlled tests that distinguish reliance on recent intent from lexical similarity and positional artifacts. Seek matched edits, position-preserving controls, and model-component ablations that can connect observed failures to positional encoding, attention, or item representations without interpreting observational sensitivity as causal evidence or accuracy.
searches.query: 2024 2025 2026 sequential recommender diagnostic controlled history perturbations positional confounding matched controls attention ablation recency intent lexical shortcut learning

searches.reason: Determine whether probes actually identify ranking failures and guide useful interventions. Seek training-prefix holdouts, hard-negative audits, popularity and history-length strata, and paired uncertainty estimates to test whether diagnostic changes predict validation HR@10 gains across all four datasets. Audit sampled versus full-catalog behavior without changing the pinned evaluator; reserve host validation for limited confirmation within the GPU budget.
